mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals robust consumer demand, driving higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production indicates stronger economic activity and corporate output, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate higher earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1250.0 thousand units signals weakening residential demand, which often precedes a broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 1250.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls and decline in the unemployment rate indicates a rapidly strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
